title: Jonah and the Oath
author: D. M. Montrose
blurb: Ines Almeida, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
